title: Part 1: The Solid That Is Secretly A Liquid
hook: Black tar shatters like glass, but it is secretly dripping right now.
script: Black tar shatters like glass, but it is secretly dripping right now. So why has this exact same substance been running since 1927 as a slow liquid? Under sudden force, its internal structure locks tight, so it looks solid. But given enough time, the material creeps downward, forming one drop per decade. It flows billions of times slower than water, making it the slowest fluid on Earth. A scientist watched it for decades and died right before it fell. To this dark fluid, a human life passes in a single drop.
